remarks: This beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 3-bath home offers living in one of Wilton's most sought-after locations near the Lake Club. Warm and inviting throughout, this home features a light-filled open-concept with eat in kitchen and huge island and living room-ideal for entertaining holidays and everyday living. A spacious dining room with fireplace offers flexibility for today's lifestyle. Relax and enjoy down time by the fire in the family room. Enjoy peaceful outdoor living on the expansive deck overlooking a professionally landscaped yard, complete with fire-pit area perfect for s'mores and gatherings. Major updates include a new roof, windows, TREX deck, boiler, hot water heater, garage doors, well pump, water softener and more. Bathrooms have been fully renovated and fresh paint add to the move-in-ready appeal. Quiet, walkable street on cul de sac -ride bikes, host parties or simply unwind in this impeccably maintained turnkey home offering quality, care and pride of ownership.
